purpose: Make campaign position and movement replayable from public operational state without persisting private reasoning.

metric.name: CATEGORICAL_HAMMING
metric.interpretation: Movement occurs only when one or more declared public axes change.

canonical_parent_chart.projection_note: The campaign chart compresses task-relevant public state for pulse routing; it does not replace the parent chart's native Git/tree/surface/operator/object/version/time/KC144/return coordinates.

projection.prompt_digest: derived digest of prompt object/version witnesses carried through parent O/V lineage
projection.frontier_digest: derived digest of frontier object/version witnesses carried through parent O/V lineage
projection.operational_basis_digest: derived digest over current execution-surface/operator descriptors associated with parent S/X/O/V
projection.issue_pressure_digest: derived digest over current issue-pressure object/version witnesses associated with parent O/V/E
projection.source_bundle_digest: derived digest over source object/version/provenance witnesses associated with parent O/V/E
projection.pulse_index: campaign curriculum coordinate; not identical to parent monotonic N
projection.authority: task-local authority standing projected from public evidence/standing; it never grants authority
loss: parent RID/AID retained as run metadata rather than hashed position axis
TR, S, X, O, V, N, K, T and R are not individually represented in the compact coordinate
one compact coordinate may correspond to multiple distinct parent-chart positions
Hamming distance measures compact-axis change only, not semantic or physical distance
